title: Northfold Manor
wikitext:
[[Image:Northfold.jpg|thumb|Northfold Manor]]

[[Northfold Manor]] is a farm on the north-western outskirts of [[Arathi Highlands]], occupied by forces of the [[Syndicate]].

A [[rare spawn]], [[Singer]] appears in one of the huts there.
